query_analysis.original_query: Our pilot plant is struggling with low-temperature hydrocarbon separation using mixed refrigerant cycles. What advanced exergy analysis techniques could help us optimize the energy efficiency?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Identify and recommend advanced exergy analysis techniques to optimize the energy efficiency of a low-temperature hydrocarbon separation process using mixed refrigerant cycles in a pilot plant.

communication_strategy.information_flow: Iterative exergy analysis and process refinement

clarification_questions: What are the specific hydrocarbons being separated and their relative concentrations?
What are the current operating conditions (temperature, pressure) of the mixed refrigerant cycles?
Are there any constraints on the modifications that can be made to the existing process?
